note: Judged 2026-10-21 against RFC 3101 Section 2.4 text. Producer ComputeExternalWith (spf/external.go) skips a Type-7 default on an NSSA border router when rec.Pref == prefType7P0 (P-bit clear), so a P-set default proceeds to externalCandidateFrom. TestOSPFNSSABorderRouterDefaultPBit: positive subtest 'P-bit set' with summaries imported requires exactly one route, 0.0.0.0/0; negative subtest 'P-bit clear', same inputs except the P-bit, asserts no route. Both directions of 'if and only if' are pinned with only the P-bit varied, so dropping the P-clear skip reddens the negative and skipping every default reddens the positive. The Section 2.5 summary-suppression skip is held apart (summaries imported in both subtests). Revert records on ComputeExternalWith are whole-body panics; the clause-level discrimination was judged by reading.
